request: When an evidence row's command fails or reaches its timeout, the refusal must carry the tail of that command's output, so the reader can act on it without running the command again.

defects.description: Own-history fix e57407e0cc (2026-10-08): fix(admit): show the tail of a failing command's output in its refusal
defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
